name: AppleTify
blurb: Minimal dark skin mixing Apple Music and Spotify: right-leaning bold lyrics with a depth blur, a dark blurred still cover backdrop on now playing, a floating pill player bar and a red accent.

name: Apple Music Refine
blurb: Apple Music skin with big bold lyrics and a depth blur, a darkened cover backdrop on every page, liquid-glass surfaces and a floating pill player bar.

name: Apple Music
blurb: Apple Music look: bold lyrics with a six-step depth blur, a saturated warped cover backdrop and a black, tightly rounded interface.

name: Burn
blurb: White lyrics that burn as they're sung: a fire-coloured band sweeps each word and leaves charred dark-red text with a thin red outline.

name: Clarity
blurb: Clean glassmorphism with heavy Figtree lyrics that slide away once sung, and a floating glass player bar with a spinning vinyl peeking out of the thumbnail.

name: Classic
blurb: Plain dark with red accents and no album-art colours.

name: Colorful Vocals
blurb: Each singer gets their own pastel colour, with a soft glow on sung words, over a dim, punchy reactive backdrop.

name: Darky
blurb: True-black frosted glass with Apple-style blurred lyrics, springy word bounces and a dark warped glow.

name: Dynamic Background
blurb: An animated cover backdrop across the whole app with frosted glass; every line but the one being sung is blurred, and sung words glow.

name: Even Better Lyrics Plus
blurb: Large Switzer lyrics; sung lines fade back and blur while upcoming ones stay brighter, over a vivid cover warp with a slowly turning blurred cover behind it.

name: Expressive
blurb: Material You Expressive: Google Sans Flex type on solid black surfaces with thin outlined menus, dialogs and player bar.

name: Fluent
blurb: Windows 11's Fluent look: Segoe UI Variable, your Windows accent colour, flat layered greys on a rounded sheet and small corners; now playing keeps a slow, calm cover backdrop.

name: Glassy Blur
blurb: Apple Music-style lyrics: sung lines vanish and upcoming lines blur progressively, over frosted glass and the song's own blurred cover on every page.

name: Lucid
blurb: Minimal frosted glass with bold lyrics that blur in a cascade as they approach and dissolve once sung, over an animated backdrop on every page.

name: Lyric Glow
blurb: An Apple Music-style dark stage: tight SF Pro lyrics, a four-step fade for the lines ahead, a soft glow behind the sung line and a faint cover warp.

name: Material 3
blurb: Google's Material 3 Expressive look: a warm dark palette, Google Sans Flex, pill search and rounded cards, with soft blurred past lines.

name: Minimal
blurb: Calm line-by-line lyrics with no karaoke wipe, over a dim, unblurred cover backdrop.

name: Minimalism Music
blurb: An Apple Music-inspired look: very large SF Pro lyrics, sung lines that vanish, a flat 75% for the lines ahead and a still, dimmed blurred cover behind.

now_playing.no_lyrics_text: You'll have to guess the lyrics for this one.

name: ModernPlayer
blurb: Clean and cinematic: a 24px-rounded cover capped at 520px with a tight shadow, a faint blurred cover behind, and depth-of-field blur on sung lines.

name: Opacity Based Karaoke
blurb: Only the line being sung is visible: each word floats up and appears as it's sung over a dim full-cover backdrop.

name: reCover
blurb: The album cover fills the screen's height on the left and fades toward the lyrics, with a small card for the song in the corner and sung lines blurred away.

name: Spicy for YouTube Music
blurb: The Spicy Lyrics look: bold lyrics that blur with distance, a springy word bounce, three-dot breaks, and a vivid, fast cover warp behind every page.

name: Spinning Record
blurb: The album art becomes a huge, darkened disc that spins without stopping and bleeds off the top-left of the window, beside softly blurred lyrics.

name: Spotifont
blurb: Lyrics in Spotify's title font, a little larger and tighter, with past lines blurred and faded and everything else stock.

name: Spotlight
blurb: Focused lyrics: dim unsung text, with already-sung lines softly blurred out.

name: Sustain
blurb: Calm and minimal: DM Sans lyrics on the left over a saturated, audio-reactive backdrop. Sung lines vanish and the next four fade out and blur away.

name: EqualTweaks
blurb: The base look with frosted-glass bars and menus, rounder covers and thumbnails, a thin outline on the cover, and larger lyrics in full screen.

name: Better-YTM
blurb: Roomy, bouncy lyrics where the sung line is large and every other line shrinks, white highlights on black, a bright reactive background and a floating player bar.

name: YouTube TV
blurb: YouTube TV-style: big lyrics on the left, a large rounded cover on the right with the song centred beneath it, sung lines vanish, and the sidebar and bar are transparent.

name: ytm-rs
blurb: The app's own look: animated album-art background, left-aligned karaoke lyrics.
